newsitem.title: USA: J&J unit sues Home Diagnostics in patent dispute.
newsitem.headline: J&J unit sues Home Diagnostics in patent dispute.

text.p: The Lifescan Inc unit of Johnson and Johnson has alleged in a lawsuit that a Home Diagnostics Inc device for monitoring blood glucose infringes a patent owned by Lifescan, court papers say.
The president of Home Diagnostics, George Holley, accused J&J of using the lawsuit to gain an economic advantage over a small company.

"This lawsuit is poppycock", Holley told Reuters on Tuesday. "They're using their legal muscle to drive the little guy out of business so they can raise prices....We're considering filing a restraint of trade lawsuit against them."

J&J spokesman Jeffrey Leebaw told Reuters that Holley's "allegation is totally outrageous. We've made a significant investment to produce this patented technology and will vigorously defend and protect out patent rights. We feel that protecting rights under patent laws is an important process."
